description: This file defines the ImportNode class within the Twig templating engine. The class represents an import node in a Twig template, handling compilation of import statements, including deprecation warnings for outdated constructor arguments, and generating PHP code to load templates.

classes.name: ImportNode
classes.description: Represents an import node in Twig templates, handling the import statement and its compilation logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an ImportNode instance, handling arguments for the expression to import, the variable assignment, and line number. Includes deprecation warnings for outdated argument patterns.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to compile the import node, handling special cases for self-imports and loading the specified template.
